items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: And this child's godfather played too in the band. And he begged, he said, George, don't go play that Bulls Parade. I'll give you that $10 out of my pocket. He said, no Brown, my word is my bond.

ctx.x: That's right. Well when he took sick, he played that Bulls Parade. And I didn't want him to go play, he was sick. He was 26. He got out of the band when he played the Bulls Parade and come home and got the band. Then the Monday, he had an Artfellas Parade across the river. And I begged him. And this child's godfather played too in the band. And he begged, he said, George, don't go play that Bulls Parade. I'll give you that $10 out of my pocket. He said, no Brown, my word is my bond.
